note: Paladin in full plate, front view, holding a huge warhammer in the left (image-left) fist. Head is the black hair and beard, bottom y~460-468 at the beard; the gorget, cuirass, belt, the central apron-like fauld plate and the red cape pieces are torso. Left arm: pauldron upper arm to the bare-skin elbow patch at y~548, vambrace forearm to y~625, bare fist y590-662 wrapped round the handle. The hammer is equipment: the head (x143-343, y430-618), the handle section above the fist (y555-612) and the handle below the fist running down-right to (398,704), kept off the fist. Right arm: pauldron plus bare upper arm to the elbow y~555 (skin patch), vambrace forearm to y~645, bare fist y643-705. Hip is the belt bottom y~650; the side tasset plates are hip armour plates and so thigh (left x378-452, right x548-655) down to the knee cops (left y768, right y780), including the bare skin showing between plates; greaves are lower leg to the ankle (left y865, right y880), sabatons are feet. The thigh/knee calls come from plate edges and are estimates.
